clusters.name: A control runs where the commits are not
clusters.description: A sample cluster for the split fixture — the verification venue differs from the venue that holds the commits
clusters.functional_ground: the venue a control runs in is chosen once and silently diverges from where the judged commits live
clusters.difficulty: A stage's control is executed in a checkout that lacks the commits it judges, so a genuinely green stage is recorded as failed.
clusters.no_principle_reason: two contexts, below the promotion threshold

clusters.name: A network call in a control hangs the engine
clusters.description: A sample cluster for the split fixture — a fetch inside an auto-run check wedges the engine
clusters.functional_ground: an auto-run check has no timeout, so any blocking call in it blocks the engine instead of failing
clusters.difficulty: A network call placed in an engine-run check never returns, and the engine, which runs it without a timeout, waits forever.
clusters.no_principle_reason: two contexts, below the promotion threshold
